name: Gregorio LSP
description: Installs gregorio-lsp language server (with grelint and grefmt) from source on Debian/Ubuntu, Red Hat/Fedora, or Alpine based systems.

host.description: Repository host platform (e.g. 'github', 'gitlab', 'codeberg', 'bitbucket'). Used to construct the repository URL.

repository.description: Repository in OWNER/REPO format (e.g. 'aiscgre-br/gregorio-lsp'). Used together with host to construct the full repository URL.

ref.description: Git reference (commit hash, tag, or branch name) to build from. Leave empty to build from the HEAD of the repository's default branch.
